description: cua-lite preprocessed version of UI-Genie-Agent (HanXiao1999/UI-Genie-Agent-16k). Mobile/Android multi-step agent trajectories from two subsets: ui_genie (UI-Genie-Agent-16k) and amex (an AMEX re-annotation). Mapped to the `use` task type with per-step action descriptions.
extra_notes: Two subsets carried as variants: ui_genie, amex. AMEX screenshots are sourced from Yuxiang007/AMEX. Coordinates are pixels in the per-step screen resolution, normalized to [0,1000].
